[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Restaurant Customers** [CSES 1619 · Restaurant Customers](https://cses.fi/problemset/task/1619)

"Max simultaneous" is a counting query over a timeline. Break each interval into a `+1` event at $a_i$ and a `-1` event at $b_i$, sort all $2N$ events, and read the running prefix sum. At any event position $t$, the running count *is* the number of customers inside at $t$. On this judge the tie-breaker never matters, because all times are distinct. It matters the moment you reuse the code on data with ties, so the code below fixes a convention on purpose: a customer leaving at $t$ is still inside at $t$ (closed intervals), which means an arrival `+1` sorts *before* a departure `-1` at the same $t$. Flip that order and the peak drops by one on touching intervals (@sec-int-repr).

[Solved in full in @sec-int-p2-a.]{.card-link}
